topic: Myth: all 21 million bitcoin can be mined
hook: Myth: all twenty-one million bitcoin will end up mined.

scenes.narration: Because the subsidy rounds down at satoshi precision, the real ceiling is slightly under twenty-one million.
The fifty bitcoin from the genesis block reward was never spendable.
Two blocks in November 2010 overwrote earlier rewards, making another hundred bitcoin unspendable.

cta: Did you know that? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Myth: All 21 Million Bitcoin Can Be Mined
description_body: The true ceiling is just under 21 million, and some coins can never move.
